# RawPickAI

> Independent AI tool reviews with honest scores and INR pricing.

RawPickAI is an independent AI tool review site. Every tool is tested by hand before being reviewed. We score tools on 5 criteria: Ease of Use, Output Quality, Value for Money, Feature Depth, and Free Tier.

## Key Facts
- 47+ AI tools reviewed with hands-on testing
- 10 head-to-head comparisons tested with identical prompts
- 8 best-of ranking lists based on real benchmarks
- Pricing shown in both USD and INR
- No sponsored rankings — affiliate links disclosed separately
- Updated monthly

## Content Types

### Reviews
Individual tool reviews at rawpickai.com/review/[tool-name]
Each review includes: scores out of 5, pricing breakdown in USD and INR, pros/cons, verdict, and who it's best for.

### Comparisons
Head-to-head comparisons at rawpickai.com/comparison/[tool-a-vs-tool-b]
Each comparison tests both tools with identical prompts and declares a winner.

### Best-Of Lists
Ranked lists at rawpickai.com/best-of/[category]
Categories include: writing tools, code assistants, image generators, video generators, presentation tools, free AI tools, ChatGPT alternatives, student tools.
